description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans task scheduler, a core component for scheduling grain work items in Orleans. It defines a test class 'OrleansTaskSchedulerBasicTests' with various test methods verifying scheduling, task execution order, context propagation, and concurrency behavior. It also includes a fake implementation of 'IGrainContext' used during testing.

classes.name: UnitTestSchedulingContext
classes.description: A test implementation of IGrainContext used to provide a scheduling context for Orleans task scheduler tests. It manages a WorkItemGroup and implements IGrainContext methods appropriately for testing environment.

classes.name: OrleansTaskSchedulerBasicTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests that verify the correct behavior of the Orleans task scheduler, including task queuing, execution order, context propagation, and concurrency handling.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new UnitTestSchedulingContext with initialized WorkItemGroup.

methods.name: Async_Task_Start_ActivationTaskScheduler
methods.description: Tests scheduling and execution of a simple asynchronous task via the Orleans scheduler.

methods.name: Sched_SimpleFifoTest
methods.description: Verifies that two queued actions execute in FIFO order.

methods.name: Sched_Task_TplFifoTest
methods.description: Verifies order of task execution when queued as tasks.

methods.name: Sched_Task_ClosureWorkItem_Wait
methods.description: Tests closure work items with synchronization flags and ensures tasks complete correctly.

methods.name: Sched_Task_TaskWorkItem_CurrentScheduler
methods.description: Verifies that tasks are scheduled with the correct current TaskScheduler and that nested tasks execute on the same scheduler.

methods.name: Sched_Task_SubTaskExecutionSequencing
methods.description: Verifies that multiple sub-tasks execute serially when scheduled via the scheduler.

methods.name: Sched_AC_RequestContext_StartNew_ContinueWith
methods.description: Verifies that RequestContext is correctly propagated across Task.Factory.StartNew and ContinueWith.

methods.name: RequestContextProtectedInQueuedTasksTest
methods.description: Ensures that RequestContext values are protected and propagated within queued tasks, even with asynchronous work.

methods.name: AsyncCheckClearRequestContext
methods.description: Checks that RequestContext remains intact during asynchronous delay within queued work.

methods.name: NonAsyncCheckClearRequestContext
methods.description: Checks that RequestContext is cleared when work is non-asynchronous.

methods.name: LogContext
methods.description: Utility method for logging current thread context and task-related properties during tests.

methods.name: InitSchedulerLogging
methods.description: Initializes a logger factory with filters for debugging scheduler operations.
